Effort vs Result Reaction Map [AGPro Series], AGProLabs, v1.3.
Original public Pine Script v6 source: agpro-effort-result-v1.3.pine
Source: https://www.tradingview.com/script/HeDQBrkV-Effort-vs-Result-Reaction-Map-AGPro-Series/
JavaScript frontend port and ECharts/HTML display adaptations: 2026-11-25.
No affiliation, endorsement or guaranteed TradingView-identical rendering/data.

The original contains no alternative license declaration. TradingView official
Publishing scripts documentation states: All open-source scripts on TradingView
use Mozilla Public License 2.0 by default; authors may specify an alternative in
the source code. https://www.tradingview.com/pine-script-docs/writing/publishing/
The original and derivative kline-agpro.js are provided in editable Source Code
Form, under MPL-2.0 (LICENSE-MPL-2.0.txt); preserve author attribution and this
notice when distributing. Other independent application files retain their own
applicable licenses. This is a local frontend port, NOT a TradingView publication.
If republishing on TradingView, its additional Open-source reuse rules apply.

Computational mapping: Pine lines 74-112 defaults; 168-216 core; 218-230
confirmation/cooldown; 239-273 single-pending close-only proof, adverse first;
281-324 last-12 labels and one replaceable/expiring current reaction range;
347-386 current panel context. No imports.
Defaults follow actual input() values, NOT contradictory tooltip prose:
showLabelConfidence=true, showMarkers=false, cooldownBars=40.
Pine SMA/RMA use full non-na seed; ATR=RMA(TR(true),14), safeATR falls back to TR
then minTick before ATR exists. RU/NR/BR minTick=5, exchange contract specs.
App conservatively excludes Shanghai-calendar today/future from AGPro input;
current-day closes are not asserted final. Pure engine also supports a single
unconfirmed final bar for confirmed-gate/unchanged-proof tests.

Display adaptations, not changes to the engine: labels use ECharts scatter-label
anchors; one HTML panel is above the plot with original names/scores and attribution.
The reaction range's theoretical right edge is event bar+32; only existing dates
are painted, with a badge centered in the visible range. No future trading dates
or candles are invented. Default markers are off, and no alert/notification is
sent. Mobile/fullscreen display is responsive, not TradingView-pixel-identical.
Only 250 Sina continuous daily candles are available, which can differ from
TradingView's data/history/adjustments; numerical parity on TradingView runtime
has not been independently measured. Historical follow-through rate is sample
statistics, not predictive accuracy, guaranteed reversal, or a top/bottom oracle.
